title: Title
description: SnapServe AI — The voice AI that never forgets. Build and deploy Indian-language voice agents with cross-call persistent memory, no code required.

title: The Team
description: Karthikeyan (Founder & CEO, CMA US) and Gopi N. (Co-Founder & COO, CGI engineer) — two builders who shipped it themselves.

title: The Problem
description: India's $40B+ BPM industry — every AI call starts from scratch, US-hosted tools don't understand India, memory loss = revenue loss.

title: The Solution
description: Memory · Language · Compliance in one platform. 10x cost advantage. Product ready and live in production.

title: Traction
description: Product live in production. 12+ Indian languages validated. BFSI pilots running. Memory working end-to-end. Converting to paid.

title: How It Works
description: 3 steps: Describe your agent → Platform auto-configures STT/LLM/TTS with TRAI/DPDP guardrails → Get a number & go live in < 5 minutes.

title: Market Opportunity
description: TAM $35.2B / SAM $957M / Beachhead BFSI. Why now: 800M connected Indians, India-first AI models arrived, DPDP/TRAI as sales advantage.

title: Business Model
description: Per-minute SaaS with two tiers: Managed (₹4.2/min) + BYOP (₹2.9/min). 10x unit economics. Two streams: No-code SaaS + Enterprise Memory API.

title: Competition & Advantage
description: 9-capability comparison: SnapServe vs Vapi/Retell/Bolna vs Status Quo. The memory moat: data that compounds and history that can't be copied.

title: Roadmap & Milestones
description: TODAY / +12 MONTHS / +2 YEARS / +5 YEARS milestones. Live in production, pilots running, scaling to ₹100 Cr ARR.

title: Financials & The Ask
description: Raising ₹3 Crore pre-seed. 45% Tech, 30% GTM, 15% Team, 10% Ops. 18-month milestones. Strategic partnerships sought.

title: Annexure 1 — Tech Stack
description: TypeScript orchestration, decoupled provider-agnostic architecture, dynamic provider selection with automatic failover.

title: Annexure 2 — Memory Layer
description: Provider-independent context layer, fact & commitment extraction after every call, OpenAI-compatible Memory Proxy API for Vapi/Bolna/Retell.

title: Annexure 3 — Compliance Matrix
description: TRAI (DND, call hours, caller ID), DPDP (consent, encryption, erasure), IRDAI (disclosure, misselling prevention). CTA: snapserve.ai
